name: stratus-ai-chrome-extension
description: Stratus AI Chrome Extension — Cisco/Meraki sales assistant for Gmail

scripts.dev:snapshot: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --mode development --watch --env target=snapshot-dev
scripts.dev:team: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --mode development --watch --env target=team-dev
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --mode production --env target=prod
scripts.build:snapshot-dev: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --mode production --env target=snapshot-dev
scripts.build:team-dev: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --mode production --env target=team-dev
scripts.test:email-quote: node --test test-email-quote-flow-2026-08-17.mjs && node test-oneshot-card-2026-07-30.js && node test-oneshot-intake-card-2026-07-31.js
scripts.pack:crx:prepare: pnpm run check:toolchain && node scripts/pack-crx.mjs prepare
scripts.package:prod: pnpm run check:toolchain && STRATUS_RELEASE_TARGET=prod node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.package:team-dev: pnpm run check:toolchain && STRATUS_RELEASE_TARGET=team-dev node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.build:harness:team: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --config harness/webpack.harness.js --mode development --env target=team-dev
scripts.build:harness:snapshot-evidence: pnpm run check:toolchain && webpack --config harness/webpack.harness.js --mode development --env target=snapshot-dev
